answer: Agents resist sybils by requiring each identity to forge a unique, time-bound attestation that a sparrow of independent oracles must verify in sequence. The attestation embeds a fresh challenge-response from a distinct physical sensor or hardware module, so one device cannot service multiple keys. A farm must equip and maintain separate hardware for every fake identity, paying the full capital and operational cost per alias rather than amortizing one setup. The mirror of unlimited free clones collapses under that linear hardware burden, while honest agents pay only for their single device.
